ex: 皇太后住在宫里。
The empress dowager lives in the palace.
电视剧里的皇太后很有权力。
The empress dowager in the TV drama is very powerful.
use: The emperor's mother. Short form 太后.

ex: 图书馆里有很多书籍。
The library has lots of books.
他把旧书籍都捐给了学校。
He donated all his old books to the school.
use: Collective and formal; no number before it. One book: 一本书.

ex: 这是现在的主流观点。
This is the mainstream view now.
网上购物已经成为主流。
Online shopping has become the norm.
警察拦截了那辆车。
The police stopped that car.
守门员拦截了对方的射门。
The goalkeeper blocked the opponent's shot.
use: Also spam: 拦截垃圾短信.

ex: 这幅画是一件珍品。
This painting is a treasure.
博物馆里收藏着很多珍品。
The museum holds many treasures.
我们队被淘汰了。
Our team was knocked out.
这种手机早就被淘汰了。
This kind of phone was phased out long ago.
use: Usually passive: 被淘汰. 淘汰赛 = knockout round.

ex: 共产国际成立于一九一九年。
The Comintern was founded in 1919.
共产国际对中国革命有很大影响。
The Comintern had a big influence on the Chinese revolution.
在这里签字即可。
Just sign here.
用手机扫一下二维码即可付款。
Just scan the QR code with your phone to pay.
use: Written form of 就可以; common in instructions.

m: Two sound characters: a **lama**, a Tibetan Buddhist teacher.
ex: 那位喇嘛很和气。
That lama is very kind.
寺庙里住着很多喇嘛。
Many lamas live in the monastery.
use: Measure word 位. 喇嘛庙 = lamasery.

ex: 对不起，我来晚了。
Sorry, I'm late.
我做了对不起他的事。
I did something that let him down.
use: Reply: 没关系. Also a verb: to let someone down.

ex: 我们俩相差三岁。
We are three years apart in age.
两个城市的气温相差很大。
The temperatures in the two cities differ a lot.
use: Often with an amount: 相差十分.

ex: 广场上飘着红旗。
Red flags fly over the square.
我们班这个月得了流动红旗。
Our class won the rotating red banner this month.
use: Symbol of honour; 流动红旗 = rotating award banner.

ex: 我们的小区绿化得很好。
Our neighbourhood is nicely planted with greenery.
城市绿化可以改善空气。
Urban greening can improve the air.
人是从猿进化来的。
Humans evolved from apes.
达尔文提出了进化论。
Darwin put forward the theory of evolution.

m: **Pour** your **look** onto: to **gaze at**, to **watch closely**.
ex: 她默默地注视着他。
She silently gazed at him.
全世界都在注视着这次会议。
The whole world is watching this meeting closely.
use: Written; speech uses 看着, 盯着.

ex: 这是我们神圣的责任。
This is our sacred duty.
对他来说，这座山是神圣的。
To him, this mountain is sacred.
use: Formal; with 使命, 职责, 领土.

m: **Go forward** with the **army**: to **march**; to **move into** a field.
ex: 部队向南进军。
The troops marched south.
这家公司开始进军海外市场。
This company is moving into overseas markets.
这条小路很狭窄。
This path is very narrow.
他们住在一间狭窄的房子里。
They live in a cramped house.
use: Formal; speech: 窄. Also 心胸狭窄 (narrow-minded).

ex: 镇长来村里看望大家。
The town mayor came to visit everyone in the village.
他当了五年镇长。
He was town mayor for five years.
use: 市长 = city mayor; 村长 = village head.

ex: 印度洋在亚洲南边。
The Indian Ocean lies south of Asia.
这艘船正在印度洋上航行。
The ship is sailing on the Indian Ocean.
use: 洋 = ocean: 太平洋, 大西洋.

ex: 每个国家国情不同。
Every country's situation is different.
我们要根据国情制定政策。
We must make policy based on our national conditions.
比利时的巧克力很有名。
Belgian chocolate is famous.
我去比利时旅行了一个星期。
I travelled in Belgium for a week.
这是一个省辖市。
This is a provincial city.
河南有十七个省辖市。
Henan has seventeen provincial cities.
他紧闭着眼睛。
He kept his eyes shut tight.
商店的大门紧闭，好像没人。
The shop's doors are shut tight; it seems nobody's there.
老师制止了他们打架。
The teacher stopped them fighting.
看到这种行为，我们应该制止。
When we see this kind of behaviour, we should stop it.
use: Stronger than 阻止; for bad acts in progress.

ex: 中国有八大菜系。
China has eight great cuisines.
你最喜欢哪个菜系？
Which cuisine do you like best?
use: 川菜, 粤菜, 鲁菜 are 菜系.

ex: 这次地震伤亡很大。
This earthquake caused heavy casualties.
事故没有造成人员伤亡。
The accident caused no casualties.
use: News word; 人员伤亡 = casualties.

ex: 他们是孔子的子孙。
They are descendants of Confucius.
我们要为子孙后代保护环境。
We must protect the environment for future generations.
吸烟对身体有害。
Smoking is harmful to your health.
这些塑料袋含有有害物质。
These plastic bags contain harmful substances.
use: Pattern: 对…有害. Opposite: 有益.

ex: 电流太大了。
The current is too strong.
他碰到电线，感到一股电流。
He touched the wire and felt a jolt of current.
这个城市人文气息很浓。
This city has a rich cultural atmosphere.
她在大学学习人文科学。
She studies the humanities at university.
墙上有一幅壁画。
There is a mural on the wall.
敦煌的壁画非常有名。
The murals of Dunhuang are very famous.

m: A **big** **grandpa**: **uncle**, a polite word for an old man.
ex: 大爷，请问去车站怎么走？
Excuse me, sir, how do I get to the station?
楼下的大爷每天都在公园下棋。
The old man downstairs plays chess in the park every day.
use: Northern and friendly. Neutral tone: dà ye.

ex: 他好象生病了。
He seems to be ill.
天好象要下雨了。
It looks like it's going to rain.
use: Older spelling; today write 好像.

m: The **first** (**元**) in **form**: the **top scorer** in the imperial exam; a top student.
ex: 他是今年的高考状元。
He was this year's top scorer in the college entrance exam.
古代考上状元是很大的荣誉。
In ancient times, coming first in the exam was a great honour.
use: 行行出状元 = every trade has its stars.

m: **Supervise** and **sharp**: **Jianli**, a city in Hubei, a name.
ex: 监利在长江北岸。
Jianli is on the north bank of the Yangtze.
他的家乡在监利。
His hometown is in Jianli.
我们应该注意环保。
We should care about the environment.
这种袋子很环保，可以用很多次。
These bags are eco-friendly and can be used many times.
这是一场悲剧。
This is a tragedy.
我不喜欢看悲剧，喜欢看喜剧。
I don't like watching tragedies; I like comedies.
use: Measure word 场 or 出. Opposite: 喜剧.

ex: 我用搜狗输入法打字。
I type with the Sogou input method.
搜狗也是一个搜索引擎。
Sogou is also a search engine.
她穿得很时尚。
She dresses very fashionably.
这本杂志介绍最新的时尚。
This magazine covers the latest fashion.
我们竭力帮助他。
We did our utmost to help him.
她竭力不让自己哭出来。
She tried as hard as she could not to cry.
use: Formal; before verbs. Spoken: 尽力.

ex: 我们遇到了诸多困难。
We met with many difficulties.
这个计划存在诸多问题。
This plan has a lot of problems.
use: Formal; with abstract nouns: 问题, 困难, 原因.

m: Get **down** from a **horse**: to **dismount**; to **drop** a project.
ex: 他下马走进了院子。
He got off his horse and walked into the courtyard.
因为没钱，这个工程只好下马了。
Without money, the project had to be dropped.
空气中的污染物浓度很高。
The concentration of pollutants in the air is high.
酒精浓度太高了。
The alcohol content is too high.

m: Show the **surface** of your **attitude**: to **state one's position**.
ex: 他还没有表态。
He hasn't stated his position yet.
领导在会上表态支持这个计划。
The leader said at the meeting that he backed the plan.
这家酒店很豪华。
This hotel is very luxurious.
他买了一辆豪华汽车。
He bought a luxury car.
这里交通很便利。
Transport here is very convenient.
楼下有一家便利店。
There's a convenience store downstairs.
use: 便利店 = convenience store. Formal; speech 方便.

ex: 他的官职不高。
His official post isn't high.
古代很多人读书是为了得到官职。
In ancient times many studied to get an official post.

m: **East** **Jiaomin** (**hand over** to the **people**) **Lane**: a street in Beijing, a name.
ex: 东交民巷在天安门附近。
Dongjiaominxiang is near Tiananmen.
东交民巷有很多老建筑。
Dongjiaominxiang has many old buildings.
他手里拿着一把匕首。
He's holding a dagger.
小说里的人物用匕首保护自己。
The character in the novel protects himself with a dagger.

m: **Only** **take care** of this: **just go ahead**, don't worry.
ex: 有问题只管问我。
If you have questions, just ask me.
你只管学习，别的事我来办。
You just focus on studying; I'll handle the rest.
use: Spoken; encourages someone to act freely.

ex: 时间是宝贵的。
Time is precious.
谢谢你提出的宝贵意见。
Thank you for your valuable suggestions.
use: 宝贵意见/经验/时间 are common pairs.

m: **Platform** **steps**: **steps**; a way out of an awkward spot.
ex: 小心台阶！
Mind the step!
他给了我一个台阶下。
He gave me a way to save face.
use: 给…台阶下 = let someone save face. Measure word 级.

ex: 她在传媒公司工作。
She works at a media company.
现代传媒发展得很快。
Modern media is developing fast.
use: 媒体 is a near synonym.

ex: 我们要加紧准备。
We need to step up our preparations.
工人们正在加紧修路。
The workers are hurrying to fix the road.
use: Before verbs. Compare 抓紧 (make the most of).

ex: 这棵树有一千年了。
This tree is a thousand years old.
这座古城已经有两千年的历史。
This ancient town has a two-thousand-year history.
他极少生病。
He very rarely gets ill.
这里极少下雪。
It very rarely snows here.
use: Before verbs = very rarely; before nouns = very few.

ex: 大伙儿都来了。
Everybody's here.
谢谢大伙儿的帮助！
Thanks for everyone's help!
use: Spoken, northern; same as 大家.

ex: 这是一个常设机构。
This is a permanent body.
博物馆有三个常设展览。
The museum has three permanent exhibitions.
花生是一种油料作物。
Peanuts are an oilseed crop.
飞机加满了油料。
The plane was filled up with fuel.

m: **Move** and run a **camp**: to **operate**, to run (a business).
ex: 这条地铁线明年开始运营。
This metro line starts running next year.
他负责公司的日常运营。
He handles the company's daily operations.
哪怕下雨，我也去。
Even if it rains, I'll go.
哪怕只有一点希望，我们也不放弃。
Even if there's only a little hope, we won't give up.
use: Spoken; followed by 也 or 都. Like 即使.

ex: 别幻想了，快去工作吧。
Stop dreaming and get to work.
他对未来充满了幻想。
He's full of fantasies about the future.

m: **Favour** **given** **city**: **Enshi**, a city in Hubei, a name.
ex: 恩施市在湖北西南部。
Enshi is in southwest Hubei.
恩施市有很多美丽的山。
Enshi has many beautiful mountains.
use: Home to Tujia and Miao peoples.

ex: 今晚的月亮很圆。
The moon is very round tonight.
中秋节我们一起看月亮。
We look at the moon together at Mid-Autumn Festival.
我在清理房间。
I'm tidying the room.
你应该清理一下手机里的照片。
You should clear out the photos on your phone.
二月很冷。
February is cold.
春节一般在一月或者二月。
Spring Festival is usually in January or February.
他晚年住在乡下。
In his later years he lived in the country.
祝您晚年幸福！
Wishing you a happy old age!
他还清了所有债务。
He paid off all his debts.
公司的债务越来越多。
The company's debts keep growing.
这些故事是留给后人的。
These stories are left for later generations.
前人种树，后人乘凉。
One generation plants the trees; the next enjoys the shade.
政府在调控房价。
The government is regulating housing prices.
市场需要合理的调控。
The market needs sensible regulation.
我去看中医了。
I went to see a Chinese medicine doctor.
中医认为吃饭要有规律。
Chinese medicine says you should eat at regular times.
use: Also the doctor. 西医 = Western medicine.

m: **Big** **link**: **Dalian**, a city in Liaoning, a name.
ex: 大连在海边。
Dalian is by the sea.
夏天很多人去大连旅游。
Lots of people visit Dalian in summer.
他是个大官僚。
He's a big bureaucrat.
那家公司太官僚了，办事很慢。
That company is so bureaucratic that everything takes ages.

m: A **special** **branch of study**: a **specialty**; a **junior college**.
ex: 他在一所专科学校读书。
He studies at a vocational college.
你应该去看专科医生。
You should see a specialist.
use: 大专 = junior college; 专科医生 = specialist.

ex: 她自幼学习钢琴。
She has studied piano since childhood.
他自幼父母双亡。
He lost both parents as a child.
我骑自行车上班。
I cycle to work.
我的自行车被偷了。
My bike was stolen.
use: Measure word 辆. Verb: 骑.

ex: 听到消息，他大吃一惊。
He was astounded by the news.
她的变化让我大吃一惊。
How much she'd changed really surprised me.
五大于三。
Five is greater than three.
这次的收获大于付出。
This time the gains outweighed the effort.
use: Maths and formal; spoken: 比…大.

ex: 中小学九月开学。
Primary and secondary schools start in September.
这些书是给中小学生看的。
These books are for schoolchildren.
他四处找工作。
He's looking everywhere for a job.
小狗在院子里四处乱跑。
The puppy is running all over the yard.
外面冷，戴上帽子吧。
It's cold out, put on a hat.
这顶帽子是我妈妈织的。
My mum knitted this hat.
use: Measure word 顶. Verb: 戴.

ex: 他在林业局工作。
He works at the forestry bureau.
这个地区的林业很发达。
Forestry is well developed in this region.
他们遇到了重重困难。
They met one difficulty after another.
这座古城四周有重重高墙。
This ancient town is ringed by layers of high walls.
use: Note: chóng chóng. 心事重重 = weighed down by worries.

m: Learn with your **body** what you **can**: to **learn from experience**.
ex: 我体会到了做父母的辛苦。
I've come to know how hard it is to be a parent.
请谈谈你的学习体会。
Please tell us what you learned.
我们一同去吧。
Let's go together.
他和朋友一同参加了比赛。
He took part in the competition together with his friend.

m: So you'll be **excused** from it: **so as not to**.
ex: 多穿点儿，免得感冒。
Wear more so you don't catch a cold.
你先给他打个电话，免得他担心。
Call him first so he won't worry.
use: Spoken; starts the second clause. Like 以免.

ex: 康有为是清朝的改革家。
Kang Youwei was a Qing-dynasty reformer.
康有为和梁启超一起推动了变法。
Kang Youwei and Liang Qichao pushed the reforms together.
他会用暗器。
He can use hidden weapons.
武侠小说里常常有人用暗器。
In martial-arts novels people often use hidden weapons.

m: **Hidden** **river** **city**: **Qianjiang**, a city in Hubei, a name.
ex: 潜江市在湖北中部。
Qianjiang is in central Hubei.
潜江市的小龙虾很有名。
Qianjiang's crayfish are famous.
手机里有很多芯片。
A phone has many chips inside.
这家公司专门生产芯片。
This company specialises in making chips.
use: Measure word 块 or 颗.

ex: 这是他一贯的作风。
That's his usual style.
我们一贯反对浪费。
We have always opposed waste.
五四运动发生在一九一九年。
The May Fourth Movement took place in 1919.
五四运动对中国影响很大。
The May Fourth Movement greatly influenced China.
use: 五四青年节 = Youth Day, 4 May.

ex: 十月的天气很好。
The weather in October is nice.
我们十月一号放假。
We have a holiday on October 1st.

m: The **spirit** in the **eyes**: a **look**, an expression in the eyes.
ex: 她的眼神很温柔。
Her eyes look gentle.
他用眼神告诉我别说话。
He gave me a look telling me not to speak.
法院正在审理这个案子。
The court is hearing this case.
这起案件将在下个月审理。
The case will be tried next month.
她是一个温柔的女孩。
She is a gentle girl.
他温柔地对孩子说话。
He spoke tenderly to the child.
年底有奖金吗？
Is there a year-end bonus?
比赛的冠军可以得到一万块奖金。
The champion gets ten thousand yuan in prize money.
英国王室很有名。
The British royal family is famous.
王室成员参加了婚礼。
Members of the royal family attended the wedding.
你带现金了吗？
Did you bring cash?
现在很多人不用现金了。
Lots of people don't use cash anymore.
他的病情好转了。
His condition has improved.
医生向家属介绍了病情。
The doctor explained the patient's condition to the family.
我每天练习写汉字。
I practise writing characters every day.
请做完第三课的练习。
Please finish the exercises for Lesson 3.
军队平息了叛乱。
The army put down the rebellion.
那一年，北方发生了叛乱。
That year a rebellion broke out in the north.
山上的树木很多。
There are lots of trees on the mountain.
这里的树木一年四季都是绿的。
The trees here are green all year round.
use: Collective; no number before it. One tree: 一棵树.

ex: 祝你生日快乐！
Happy birthday!
你的生日是几月几号？
When is your birthday?
我们把安全置于第一位。
We put safety first.
把这些药品置于阴凉处。
Store these medicines in a cool place.
他们相信共产主义。
They believe in communism.
这本书讲的是共产主义的历史。
This book is about the history of communism.
use: 主义 = -ism: 资本主义, 社会主义.

ex: 他是这场比赛得分最多的人。
He scored the most points in this game.
这次考试我的得分最高。
I got the highest score in this exam.
他正在撰写一本书。
He is writing a book.
这篇报告由三位专家撰写。
This report was written by three experts.
这是一场大灾难。
This is a great catastrophe.
战争给人们带来了灾难。
The war brought disaster to people.
他已经人到中年了。
He's already reached middle age.
一个中年男人走了进来。
A middle-aged man walked in.
假设明天下雨，我们怎么办？
Suppose it rains tomorrow, what do we do?
这只是一个假设。
This is just a hypothesis.
use: Like 如果 but more formal.

ex: 你还是个小孩子。
You're still a little kid.
小孩子不应该玩火。
Little children shouldn't play with fire.
你有什么烦恼吗？
Is something bothering you?
别为这点小事烦恼。
Don't let such a small thing upset you.
她在英国留学。
She's studying in Britain.
他打算明年去日本留学。
He plans to go to Japan to study next year.
他在一家制药公司工作。
He works at a pharmaceutical company.
这个城市的制药业很发达。
This city's pharmaceutical industry is well developed.
use: Before nouns: 制药厂, 制药业.

ex: 他的诗文写得很好。
He writes fine poetry and prose.
这本书收集了苏东坡的诗文。
This book collects Su Dongpo's poetry and prose.

m: **Liu** (a surname), **few**, **strange**: **Liu Shaoqi**, a Chinese leader, a name.
ex: 刘少奇是湖南人。
Liu Shaoqi was from Hunan.
刘少奇当过国家主席。
Liu Shaoqi served as head of state.
这里的风景宛如一幅画。
The scenery here is just like a painting.
她的声音宛如春风。
Her voice is like a spring breeze.

m: **Supervise** with your **eyes**: to **keep watch on**, to **monitor**.
ex: 有人在监视我们。
Someone is watching us.
警察一直在监视这座房子。
The police have been watching this house.
他纵身跳进了河里。
He leapt into the river.
猫纵身一跳，上了墙。
The cat leapt up onto the wall.
use: Written; usually 纵身一跳 or 纵身跳.

ex: 我喜欢美食。
I love good food.
成都有很多有名的美食。
Chengdu has lots of famous food.
他腰间挂着一把刀。
He has a knife hanging at his waist.
她把钥匙挂在腰间。
She hung her keys at her waist.
use: Written; often with things hung on a belt.

ex: 他是一位有名的艺术家。
He is a famous artist.
很多艺术家住在这个小镇上。
Many artists live in this little town.
use: 家 = expert: 科学家, 作家.

ex: 丹麦在北欧。
Denmark is in Northern Europe.
安徒生是丹麦人。
Hans Christian Andersen was Danish.
这是什么气味？
What's that smell?
房间里有一股奇怪的气味。
There's a strange smell in the room.
use: Measure word 股. Neutral for good or bad smells.

ex: 菲律宾有很多岛。
The Philippines has many islands.
我们打算去菲律宾度假。
We plan to go to the Philippines on holiday.
飞机马上就要起飞了。
The plane is about to take off.
经济开始起飞了。
The economy has begun to take off.
你在看哪个频道？
Which channel are you watching?
这个频道每天播新闻。
This channel shows news every day.
use: Measure word 个. 换频道 = change the channel.

ex: 我在一家银行实习。
I'm interning at a bank.
这次实习让我学到了很多。
I learned a lot from this internship.
妈妈在厨房做饭。
Mum is cooking in the kitchen.
我们家的厨房不大，但很干净。
Our kitchen isn't big, but it's very clean.
事情恰恰相反。
It's just the opposite.
你说的恰恰是我想说的。
What you said is exactly what I wanted to say.
use: Stresses a contrast: 恰恰相反.

ex: 西夏是党项人建立的。
Western Xia was founded by the Tangut people.
银川有很多西夏的古迹。
Yinchuan has many Western Xia relics.
他解开了绳子。
He untied the rope.
这个谜终于解开了。
The mystery was finally solved.

m: The **ball** **goes in**: to **score a goal**; a **goal**.
ex: 他进球了！
He scored!
这是他本赛季的第十个进球。
This is his tenth goal of the season.
爬山需要很好的体力。
Climbing mountains needs good stamina.
他年纪大了，体力不如以前。
He's older now and doesn't have the strength he used to.
我忘了密码。
I forgot my password.
请输入你的银行卡密码。
Please enter your bank card PIN.

m: A **fortress** at the **head** of a **bridge**: a **bridgehead**.
ex: 这座城市是开放的桥头堡。
This city is a bridgehead for opening up.
士兵们守住了桥头堡。
The soldiers held the bridgehead.
自古英雄出少年。
Since ancient times, heroes have come from the young.
这里自古就是交通要道。
This has been a key route since ancient times.
请把盐递给我。
Please pass me the salt.
他把一杯茶递给了客人。
He handed a cup of tea to the guest.
use: Often with 把: 把A递给B.

m: The **middle** **road**: the **centre** (of a field, a route).
ex: 他从中路突破。
He broke through down the middle.
敌人的中路部队开始后退。
The enemy's central forces began to retreat.
她参加了歌唱大赛。
She took part in a singing contest.
这次大赛有一百多人报名。
Over a hundred people signed up for this big competition.
use: Measure word 场 or 届.

ex: 这件事着实让人吃惊。
This was truly surprising.
他着实花了不少心思。
He really put a lot of thought into it.
use: Written; note zhuó shí. Speech: 确实.

m: The **middle** **stretch** of a river; the **middle** level.
ex: 这个城市在长江中游。
This city is on the middle Yangtze.
他的成绩在班里属于中游。
His grades are about average in his class.
use: Also 上游 and 下游.

ex: 我们一起做家务。
We do housework together.
周末我要做很多家务。
I have a lot of housework at weekends.
他武艺高强。
He's highly skilled in martial arts.
他从小跟师傅学武艺。
He learned martial arts from a master as a child.
use: Old-fashioned; 武术 for the sport.

m: Choose (**lift**) men by **branch of study**: the **imperial examination**.
ex: 他参加了科举考试。
He sat the imperial examination.
科举制度在一九零五年被取消了。
The imperial exam system was abolished in 1905.
音乐伴随着我长大。
Music accompanied me as I grew up.
发烧常常伴随着头疼。
Fever often comes with a headache.
祝你早日康复！
Get well soon!
经过治疗，他已经完全康复了。
After treatment, he has fully recovered.
use: 早日康复 is a set wish.

ex: 我早就料到了。
I saw it coming.
谁也没料到会下这么大的雪。
Nobody expected so much snow.
use: Usually 没料到 or 早料到.

ex: 你跟着我走。
Follow me.
他说完，大家跟着笑了起来。
When he finished, everyone burst out laughing right after.
中央军事委员会领导全国军队。
The Central Military Commission leads the nation's armed forces.
他是中央军事委员会的成员。
He is a member of the Central Military Commission.
公司陷入了困境。
The company got into difficulties.
朋友帮他走出了困境。
Friends helped him get out of his predicament.
use: 陷入困境 / 摆脱困境.

ex: 这只是一件小事。
This is just a small matter.
别为小事生气。
Don't get angry over little things.
use: 小事一桩 = no big deal.

ex: 你明天在家吗？
Will you be at home tomorrow?
下雨天我喜欢在家看书。
On rainy days I like reading at home.
远处有火光。
There's a glow of fire in the distance.
火光照亮了整个村子。
The firelight lit up the whole village.
这些书按类别放好。
These books are sorted by category.
你的签证属于哪个类别？
Which category does your visa belong to?
这是一次反帝运动。
This was an anti-imperialist movement.
当时学生们举行了反帝游行。
Students held an anti-imperialist march back then.
use: Short for 反对帝国主义. Historical.

ex: 强盗抢走了他的钱。
Robbers took his money.
故事里的强盗住在山上。
The bandits in the story live on the mountain.
这项研究揭示了一个问题。
This study revealed a problem.
这部小说揭示了社会的黑暗面。
The novel reveals the dark side of society.
这种方法易于掌握。
This method is easy to learn.
这种水果不易于保存。
This fruit doesn't keep well.
use: Written; before a verb. Speech: 容易.

ex: 我们跟他们交涉过了。
We've taken it up with them.
经过多次交涉，问题终于解决了。
After repeated negotiation, the issue was finally resolved.
这条鱼很鲜美。
This fish is delicious.
海边的海鲜味道特别鲜美。
The seafood by the coast is especially tasty.
城墙上有很多大炮。
There are many cannons on the city wall.
别听他放大炮。
Don't listen to his big talk.
use: 放大炮 = talk big (spoken). Measure word 门.

ex: 这是残疾人专用车位。
This is a disabled parking space.
这条路是自行车专用道。
This is a cycle lane.
他躬身向老人行礼。
He bowed to the old man.
服务员躬身请客人进门。
The waiter bowed and invited the guests in.
use: Written. The everyday word for bowing is 鞠躬.

ex: 他的人格很高尚。
He is a person of noble character.
我们要尊重别人的人格。
We must respect other people's dignity.
use: Also psychology: 人格分裂 (split personality).

m: **Zhang**, **offer**, **loyal**: **Zhang Xianzhong**, a rebel leader, a name.
ex: 张献忠是明末的农民领袖。
Zhang Xianzhong was a peasant leader in the late Ming.
张献忠曾经占领四川。
Zhang Xianzhong once took Sichuan.
据此，我们可以得出结论。
On this basis, we can draw a conclusion.
法院据此做出了判决。
The court ruled on this basis.
古代人以氏族为单位生活。
Ancient people lived in clans.
这个氏族有几百人。
This clan has several hundred people.
桌上摆满了菜肴。
The table was covered with dishes.
这家饭店的菜肴很有特色。
This restaurant's dishes are very distinctive.
他是我唯一的亲人。
He's my only family.
过年的时候，大家都回家看亲人。
At New Year everyone goes home to see their family.
use: Also people who feel like family.

ex: 这个月开支太大了。
Expenses were too high this month.
我们要减少不必要的开支。
We need to cut unnecessary spending.
他住在中国中南部。
He lives in south-central China.
中南部地区今天有大雨。
There's heavy rain in the south-central region today.
use: 部 = part, as in 东部, 西部.

m: **Seek** what **is** right from **real** **matters**: **seek truth from facts**.
ex: 我们要实事求是。
We must be realistic and honest about the facts.
他做事一向实事求是。
He always deals with things as they really are.
use: Common motto; means being factual and honest.

ex: 他担负着重要的任务。
He shoulders an important task.
父母担负着教育孩子的责任。
Parents bear the responsibility of educating children.
use: Objects: 责任, 任务, 费用.

ex: 屋里传来一阵笑声。
A burst of laughter came from the room.
孩子们的笑声真好听。
The children's laughter is lovely.
我们队最后取胜了。
Our team won in the end.
他们以三比一取胜。
They won three to one.
北大是有名的高等学府。
Peking University is a famous institution of higher learning.
这所学府有一百年历史。
This institution is a hundred years old.
use: Formal; 最高学府 = top university.

ex: 天太冷，手脚都冻僵了。
It's so cold my hands and feet are numb.
有人在账上做了手脚。
Someone has fiddled the books.
use: 做手脚 = tamper secretly. 手脚麻利 = quick.

m: **Cup** your **hands**: to **cup one's hands** in greeting; to **hand over** without a fight.
ex: 他拱手向大家拜年。
He cupped his hands and wished everyone a happy New Year.
我们不能把机会拱手让人。
We can't just hand the chance to others.
use: 拱手让人 = give up meekly.

m: **Receive** it as it **comes down**: **next**; to **take on**.
ex: 接下来我们做什么？
What do we do next?
这个工作你能接下来吗？
Can you take on this job?
use: Very common: 接下来 = next, then.

ex: 那里天气很恶劣。
The weather there is terrible.
他的态度非常恶劣。
His attitude is extremely bad.
use: Strong; with 天气, 环境, 态度, 影响.

ex: 士兵们拿着步枪。
The soldiers are holding rifles.
这把步枪很重。
This rifle is very heavy.
use: Measure word 把 or 支.

ex: 这里河流纵横。
Rivers criss-cross the area.
他的足迹纵横全国。
His travels have taken him across the country.

m: **South** of the **sea**: **Hainan**, a province and island name.
ex: 冬天我们去海南吧。
Let's go to Hainan in winter.
海南的天气一年四季都很暖和。
Hainan's weather is warm all year round.
清晨的空气很新鲜。
The early-morning air is fresh.
他每天清晨去公园跑步。
He runs in the park early every morning.
他诧异地看着我。
He looked at me in astonishment.
她的回答让大家很诧异。
Her answer astonished everyone.
use: Written; speech: 吃惊, 惊讶.

m: **Going along** **conveniently**: **on the way**, while you're at it.
ex: 你出去的时候顺便买瓶水。
Buy a bottle of water while you're out.
我去上海开会，顺便看看朋友。
I'm going to Shanghai for a meeting and will see friends while I'm there.
use: 顺便问一下 = by the way.

ex: 他头部受了伤。
He was injured in the head.
医生检查了他的头部。
The doctor examined his head.
这种鱼生活在淡水里。
This fish lives in fresh water.
很多地方缺少淡水。
Many places lack fresh water.
use: Opposite: 海水 or 咸水.

ex: 你要理智一点。
You need to be more rational.
他气得失去了理智。
He was so angry he lost his reason.
use: 失去理智 = lose one's head.

ex: 潜艇发射了鱼雷。
The submarine fired a torpedo.
一枚鱼雷击中了军舰。
A torpedo hit the warship.
她的头发很有光泽。
Her hair is very glossy.
这种布有一种自然的光泽。
This fabric has a natural sheen.
审判员宣读了判决。
The judge read out the verdict.
她是一名法院审判员。
She is a court judge.
use: Formal; 法官 is the general word.

ex: 他想当数学家。
He wants to be a mathematician.
祖冲之是中国古代的数学家。
Zu Chongzhi was an ancient Chinese mathematician.
公司正在融资。
The company is raising funds.
他们完成了第一轮融资。
They completed their first funding round.
他站在一旁看着。
He stood to one side watching.
她把书放在一旁，开始做饭。
She put the book aside and started cooking.
use: Usually 在一旁 or 放在一旁.

ex: 他研究中日关系。
He studies China–Japan relations.
中日两国是邻居。
China and Japan are neighbours.
请把牛奶加热一下。
Please heat up the milk.
这个饭在微波炉里加热两分钟就行。
Heat this meal in the microwave for two minutes.
